name: Sreetanwi Chakraborty

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sreetanwi Chakraborty is a bilingual poet, translator and academic whose work also includes literary editing. Her publisher identifies her with Amity University, Kolkata, and the journal Litinfinite. Her poetry collection Medusa Says it All, published by Red River in 2024, draws myth into questions of gender, exclusion and unheard voices. She is also among the translators of Ekram Ali’s Bengali poems in Atomicity.

“Frills of the Autumn” turns a season into the texture of remembered love. Dried leaves, lingering cologne, a dark night and promises associated with the Ganges give absence a physical presence. The poem moves between softness and abrasion, ending in a paradox where pain and victory occupy the same intimate space. Its layered sensory images make memory feel both cherished and difficult to inhabit.
